trap.label: were to
trap.wrong: If funding will stop, we close.
trap.right: If funding were to stop, we would close.
trap.why: O português usa futuro do subjuntivo (“se parar”). Em inglês, hipótese improvável: were to + base, com would na principal.

mcq.q: If funding ___ to stop, we would close.
___ funding to stop, we would close.

fix.wrong: Were funding to stops, we would close.
fix.right: Were funding to stop, we would close.

fix.wrong: If funding will stop, we close.
fix.right: If funding were to stop, we would close.

fix.wrong: Was it not for volunteers, we would close.
fix.right: Were it not for volunteers, we would close.
